NEW EVENTS — NATURE, ECOLOGY AND ANIMALS (NAT-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Isola's animals, plants, tides and weather: tide pools and nesting beaches, washed-up rubbish, shrinking clam beds, strange visitors, creatures doing what creatures do, and choices about the island where nobody gets a perfect answer.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

collection.description: Thousands of yellow butterflies fly over the village and out to sea, and a villager stands with arms out as they pass.

setup.name: The scene
setup.text: It starts with one yellow butterfly in the morning. Then ten. Then, by midday, the air over the village is full of them, thousands upon thousands, all flying the same way, low over the huts, over the gardens, out over the beach and across the sea toward somewhere nobody has ever been. (name1) stands in the middle of the clearing with (his/her) arms out and lets them pass around (him/her) like warm yellow rain. Children run in circles. A pig sneezes one out of its nose and looks offended. Nobody does any work at all. By evening the last of them has gone, and the sky is empty and ordinary again, and (name1) is not sure (he/she) will ever see anything like it in (his/her) life again. (He/she) hopes (he/she) will.
